properties.name: RV Vidyanikethan campus
properties.source: Drawn by hand (red line) on a Google Maps satellite screenshot, 2026-11-18. Georeferenced by fitting OSM way/55685638 to it (94% overlap, about 0.43 m per pixel); the OSM building outlines then sat on the satellite roofs. Expect a few metres of error from the marker width.
